affected_consumers: SDK conformance harness, synthetic test providers and independent constructed consumer only

excluded.legacy scientific and graphical suites: No existing src/wenu code, scientific resource, root runtime dependency or product path changes; existing Wenu does not import the SDK conformance module.
excluded.unrelated providers: No real provider is part of this slice; neither SDK nor test fixtures import one.
excluded.release integration: No product routing or installed combination changes; isolated-wheel evidence is required before this foundation can be accepted. Final integration remains required for K3 production adapters.

collection_change: none; root pytest remains scoped to tests and the kernel retains its explicit independent gate

verification.source_digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted repository path + NUL + exact file bytes + NUL for every Python file in the named directory
verification.external_consumer: separate -I -S subprocess imports only installed SDK and its own constructed provider; repository fixtures absent
fault_injection: bad provider ordering, metadata propagation, history-dependent output, unobserved evaluation, missing reuse case, corrupt certificate and impure planner fail the shipped kit
disabled metadata purity guard fails harness meta-tests
disabled failed-admission cleanup fails harness meta-tests
disabled canonical planning purity guard fails harness meta-tests

existing_test_changes.change: Rename the test-side mixin to SyntheticProviderChecks and clarify its fixture-specific scope; all existing test method ASTs, assertions and collected IDs are unchanged.
Also import the optional shipped conformance module under -I -S; retain all forbidden dependency assertions.
